# Prompt Library (Root Repo)

This folder mirrors prompt-driven workflows used in generated projects and
reference repositories (including `reference_automation`) for parity of agentic
operating patterns.

## Scope

- Root `.github/prompts/` is for **template development workflows**.
- Generated-project prompts live in `template/.github/prompts/`.

## Conventions

- Use `*.prompt.md` naming.
- Keep prompts action-oriented and idempotent where possible.
- Follow rules in `.github/instructions/prompt.instructions.md`.
